mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% triggers a negative 20-day forward return as higher interest rates compress equity discount rates, reducing future cash flow valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand, driving positive 20-day forward returns as both sectors expand equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% triggers positive 20-day forward returns as low unemployment signals strong labor market strength, boosting corporate profits and equity prices.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 5.0% in the low unemployment regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust supply-side growth, compressing inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO is rising above 105.0 in the expanding supply chain.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% during a late-cycle expansion signals accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS falls below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) creates a dual positive labor market signal, driving positive 5-day forward returns as both indicators suggest economic strength.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in the described direction concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 triggers positive 60-day forward returns as robust supply-side activity reduces inflationary pressures and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 105.0 in the expanding economy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained GDP growth (GDPC1) above 16,000 in a late-cycle expansion signals robust demand, driving positive 20-day forward returns as corporate earnings and consumer spending rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 16000 in the late-cycle expansion.
